info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interactive Help Management API
info.description: The Interactive Help Management API provides an innovative solution for enhancing customer support and seamless user experiences across banking channels. This API facilitates updates to interactive help content, allowing businesses to adapt to evolving user needs effectively. Typical consumers include customer service teams and support applications that require real-time updates to help resources. Use cases include tailoring assistance features, ensuring users receive relevant guidance, and improving customer satisfaction through personalized help experiences.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the interactive help resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes of the resource to ensure it meets the latest requirements or fixes any issues present.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to update the interactive help resource identified by RES-100045. The specified fields will be modified based on the provided data.
